t: For premises on the west side of Mission street, 839.69 feet south of Onondaga street.

Perdue & Hoffman be and are hereby granted permission, revocable at will of the Board of Supervisors, to maintain and operate an automobile supply station on the west side of Mission street, 839.69 feet south of Onondaga street.
pl: Perdue & Hoffman allowed a filling station on Mission Street

t: The rights granted under this resolution shall be exercised within six months, otherwise said permit shall become null and void.
pl: Permit on Mission Street near Onondaga Street good six months
